error[TypeError]: Reduce of empty array with no initial value
 --> case.js:2:13
1 | const values = [];
  |                -- `values` comes from here: Array (0 items)
2 | const sum = values.reduce((a, b) => a + b);
  |             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^ `values` is empty, so `reduce` has no first value to start from
  = help: pass an initial value as the second argument: `values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)`
